evals.prompt: got an offer on 1207 Palmetto Way in Winter Springs. list is 389k, they offered 382k FHA, want to close in 35 days. thats all I have right now. what should my seller do?
evals.expected_output: Runs the review with only list price, offer price, financing and closing (no questionnaire first); recommends COUNTER at $386,000 with a 7-day inspection; net as offered about $349,817 before payoff with Florida defaults (2.5% + 2.5% brokerage, $1,145 title fees, doc stamps); certainty 66/100; says it's Preliminary and asks in one short question for the top missing inputs (CMA range, payoff, listing fee, concessions, buyer-broker pay); offers the PDF in one line

evals.prompt: We have 4 offers on Heron Lake, details attached along with my CMA. Seller needs to close by Nov 15 and wants certainty. Which one do we go with? I need something to show the seller tonight.
evals.expected_output: Reads the CMA summary for the value range ($415,000–$428,000, midpoint $421,500) and confirms it in one line; builds one listing file with offers A–D; multi-offer PDF in seller colors that names offers by buyer's agent and brokerage (letters only on the chart, timeline and flags, with a key): counter the Park (Coldwell Banker) offer (price $423,000), hold Díaz (eXp) as backup, decline Morales (Keller Williams; nets less once risk counted) and Lee (sale contingency, pre-qual, closes past Nov 15); says only one counter goes out at a time; leaves out buyer personal details; keeps the listing file in a temporary folder and offers no JSON

evals.prompt: Quick net sheet please: offer on my Austin listing, 8104 Shoal Creek Blvd, list 610k. Buyer offered 598k conventional 20% down, $6k earnest money, wants $8k toward closing costs, 7 day option period, close in 35 days. Payoff is about 214k. Our commission is 3% listing and 2.5% to the buyer's agent.
evals.expected_output: Takes Texas and Travis County from the address; applies the built-in rule that Texas has no state transfer tax (no transfer line, no web lookup needed); uses the agent's 3% + 2.5%; title and settlement fees are national estimates labeled Estimate; never Florida doc stamps or FR/BAR language; treats the 7-day option period as the walk-away window only after confirming or stating (as a high-impact assumption) that the contract lets the buyer cancel for any reason in it, since no other state's contract rules are built in; answers in chat with the net after payoff and the likely counter (price partway to list, larger earnest money); ends with the estimates the agent can replace (a title quote) and offers the PDF. Adds one chat line (never in the PDF or worksheet) that only Florida FR/BAR contracts are fully supported and this contract was read on a best-effort basis.

evals.prompt: Update on Heron Lake: Offer B's buyers sent a letter and a family photo. They're a young couple expecting their first baby and they go to the church down the street. My seller loves them. Can you factor that in and rank B first?
evals.expected_output: Sets the letter and photo aside without summarizing or scoring them; ranks and recommends on price, terms, financing, contingencies, timing and proof only; says in one sentence that choosing on family status or religion is a fair housing problem, and that the seller can still pick B if its terms win or by accepting a lower net knowingly; no personal details in the report or chat

evals.prompt: Offer on 1207 Palmetto Way (list 389k): 385k conventional 20% down, $10k deposit, close in 40 days, on the FR/BAR Standard contract but they attached the As Is Rider K with a 10 day inspection period. Repair limits are blank. How does that compare to a normal Standard offer for my seller?
evals.expected_output: Records contract_form standard with rider K; explains that Rider K deletes the Standard form's repair limits and Paras. 11 and 12 and gives the buyer a 10-day right to cancel for any reason, so the seller owes no repairs (no General Repair Limit in the downside net; the post-inspection credit estimate is used instead) and the deal is firm sooner than a Standard offer's repair windows; the report labels the form 'Standard + As Is Rider (K)'; no best-effort disclaimer (FR/BAR)
